title: Forming an LLC: state filing and registered agent

sources.claim: The SBA lists the launch steps (choose a structure, register, get federal and state tax IDs, apply for licenses and permits, open a business bank account, get insurance) as a general guide.

Example of a state rule (Washington): the registered agent address must be a physical street address in the state where the agent can accept service; PO Boxes and private or virtual mailboxes may not be used for it, though a PO Box may be listed as a separate mailing address. Other states have their own rules.

sections.skill: Order the steps of forming an LLC and explain the registered agent

questions.prompt: What does a registered agent do?

choices.text: Accepts official legal papers for the business
Opens and manages the business's bank account
Files the owner's personal tax return every spring
Designs the logo and picks brand colors for the LLC

questions.correct_answer: Accepts official legal papers for the business
questions.intro: Forming an LLC, at a basic level: (1) choose a name that the state will accept; (2) name a registered agent, a person or company with a physical address in the state who accepts official legal papers for the business during business hours; (3) file formation papers (often called articles of organization) with the state and pay the fee; (4) write an operating agreement; (5) then handle tax IDs, licenses and a bank account. Many states do not accept a PO Box for the registered agent. Steps and fees vary by state; check the state's official business filing site.
questions.feedback: The registered agent receives official notices and legal papers.

questions.intro: Picture the front desk of an office building. When an important letter arrives, someone at the desk signs for it and makes sure it gets to the right person. A registered agent is the business's official front desk for legal papers. That is why the agent needs a real street address in the state and must be available during business hours: someone has to be there to receive the papers.
